design_context: Clinical decision-support dashboard / health monitoring SaaS

surfaces.alerts: rounded-md border p-4 flex items-start gap-4

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-[#4A5D4E] px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-[#3B4A3E] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4A5D4E] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-stone-200 bg-white px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-stone-900 transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-stone-200 focus:ring-offset-2

inputs.text: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-stone-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-stone-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4A5D4E] focus:border-transparent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

charts.style: minimal grid lines (strokeDasharray='3 3', stroke='#E5E7EB'), smooth curves (type='monotone'), no heavy drop shadows.

hero_background.description: Soft muted blue and white gradient background, perfect for a calming landing page hero section.

clinical_environment.description: Clean, well-lit modern clinical room, establishing medical authority and trust.

recovery_lifestyle.description: Hands journaling next to a plant, representing the daily check-in and recovery process.

abstract_nature_accent.description: Calming plant shadow on a textured wall, useful for empty states or subtle section breaks.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a React-based SPA with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI. All components must be in JS (no TS).
instructions_to_main_agent.design_system: Strictly follow the color and typography rules. The UI must feel like 'The Lancet meets Linear'—highly readable, structured, and clinically serious, yet approachable via warm earthy tones (sage/stone). Avoid purple/neon.
instructions_to_main_agent.xai_implementation: The Explainable AI (XAI) feature is core. Whenever a Risk Score is shown, it must be accompanied by an Explainable AI Panel (feature contribution bar chart or text breakdown) explaining WHY the score exists (e.g., 'Sleep decreased (-2h) -> +15 Risk').
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_rules: Do not overuse heavy shadows. Use flat surfaces with 1px stone-200 borders. The layout should be dense but highly readable (Mode B: Control Room grid).
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react (default). Keep icon usage functional, not decorative.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='daily-checkin-submit').
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Ensure navigation is clear with distinct views for Recovery User, Supporter, and Clinician, gated by simple state-based role selection.
